title: Fubble's Cursed Foods
description: Includes some weird cursed foods. Also has structures and advancements. This mod is for Java addition.
body: There is 37 foods, 11 achievments, 3 mobs, and 3 structures. Some include Lava Chicken, A Lava chicken shop, 3 different omlates, (why did people really want omlates?) Cluckbooms, and a achivement for eating all of the mod's foods. I got these from you guys on reddit and the Knarfy discord server.
